rankings.good: Bryce Young and Shough are putting up real QB points (88 and 81) and JT is still a top 5 back. The bones are there.
rankings.bad: 0-3, 2nd lowest scoring, and the next three are Tony, Nfatboy and D. He's got 7 RBs and no healthy WR1. Has to trade RBs for receivers this week or it's over.

rankings.good: McBride is a cheat code at TE and Puka is coming back. Three QBs means once Caleb's healthy the OP slot is locked.
rankings.bad: 0-3 and the next three are Big Sham, Seeberger and Tony, three of the top four scoring teams. Could be 0-6 before Puka plays a snap.

rankings.good: Hurts and Chase is a real 1-2, and Kyren is sitting on his bench. That's an RB1 he isn't even using.
rankings.bad: Lowest scoring team in the league at 105 a game, Maye just went negative and he's got one of the two hardest remaining schedules. Needs a QB in a superflex league today.

rankings.good: CeeDee and Watson are a top WR duo and Bowers is back. Once Daniels returns this lineup has no holes.
rankings.bad: Until Daniels is back he's starting Mariota and Penix in superflex, so he's losing the QB matchup every week. Next three are EN, Reece and Nfatboy. Has to steal two.

rankings.good: 3rd in scoring at 157 a game, so 1-2 is pure bad luck. Stafford, Cousins and Herbert is three QBs. He's going to win a lot from here.
rankings.bad: Week 8 bye takes CMC, Olave and Kittle at the same time. Plan for it now or that's a free L.

rankings.good: Bijan is a weekly 25 and once Baker's back he's got 3 QBs and 8 WRs. That's a lot of trade bait.
rankings.bad: 2-1 but 7th in scoring at 127 a game. Behind Bijan it's Aaron Jones and Hampton, and Rice and Nabers haven't shown up. The record is better than the team.

rankings.good: 4th in scoring at 153 a game and Gibbs is the best player in fantasy. Dak, Burrow and Darnold means a QB injury doesn't sink him.
rankings.bad: Zay, Evans and DJ Moore are all questionable and Parker Washington is somehow the WR1 in points. Needs one real WR.

rankings.good: Allen is the best floor in fantasy, he's 2nd in scoring at 161 a game, and he's got the easiest remaining schedule in the league. That's a playoff team.
rankings.bad: Five RBs and the WRs are a 33 year old Davante and a banged up McConkey. Trade Swift for a WR now while he still has value.

rankings.good: Purdy, Lamar and Malik Willis. Three startable QBs in superflex is the most valuable thing you can have once byes and injuries hit.
rankings.bad: 3-0 but only 5th in scoring at 139 a game. Points stick, records don't. Unless JJ wakes up, regression is coming.

rankings.good: Goff, Mahomes and Stroud in a superflex league is the cheat code. A QB goes down and he doesn't even notice.
rankings.bad: WR2 is a mess. Nico's hurt again and Burden and Jameson are boom or bust. Should flip some of that QB depth for a real WR2 before the deadline.
